تزدرعن (form VIII)
# تَزْدَرِعْنَ (tazdariʕna) /taz.da.riʕ.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِزْدَرَعَ (izdaraʕa)
# تُزْدَرَعْنَ (tuzdaraʕna) /tuz.da.raʕ.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِزْدَرَعَ (izdaraʕa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
